about: Stops: off the line, the same station twice, times missing or out of order, a train that turns back, a line that is not there.
problems: train "1", stop 1 "A": is the first stop, which only has a departure time
train "1", stop 2 "X": is not a station of line "l"
train "1", stop 3 "X": is not a station of line "l"
train "1", stop 3 "X": is the same station as the stop before it
train "2", stop 2 "B": arrives at 08:59, which is not after the train leaves the stop before at 09:00
train "2", stop 2 "B": leaves at 08:58, before it arrives at 08:59
train "2", stop 3 "C": is the last stop, which only has an arrival time
train "2", stop 3 "C": turns back along line "l"; a train goes one way along a line, and a loop line is marked as one
train "3": another train has the same number
train "3": the type must not start or end with a space or contain a control character
train "3", stop 2 "B": needs an arrival time
trains[4]: the number must be 1 to 32 characters, with no space at either end and no control character
